title: 补衣人的针
text: 避风处挂着几件补过许多次的外衣。补衣人指了指断开的腰带：“皮子或者布都行。我不缺针，缺的是能缝上去的东西。”她打开钱袋，让你看见里面确实还有零钱。

texts.en: A few coats, patched many times over, hang in the lee of the wind. The mender points at a broken belt. "Leather or cloth, either will do. I've needles enough; what I lack is something to sew on." She opens her purse to show you there really are coins in it.

outcomes.text: 她展开布边，看过没有霉斑的部分，把钱放进你手中。

texts.en: She unrolls the edge, checks the part free of mildew and puts the coins in your hand.

outcomes.text: 你收好材料，她低头继续缝补那条旧腰带。

texts.en: You put your materials away, and she bends back over the old belt.
